contacto.cierre: Looking for someone who turns manual processes into automated workflows and data into decisions? Let’s talk.

perfil: Data and automation analyst with retail experience. I work end to end, from process discovery to production, with Power BI, Python, Power Automate, n8n and Odoo.

At Boson Innovation I built an AI assistant on top of Odoo that answers management's questions in natural language, the consolidated sales dashboard used by 4 companies and 12 locations, and a mobile inventory count module; I also took part in implementing a multi-site architecture on Odoo 18. Before that, at CasaLinda, I automated reports and processes that used to take weeks with Power BI, Power Automate, n8n and Python.
I am a tenth-semester Systems Engineering student at Universidad César Vallejo (top 20% of my class).

proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: An assistant inside Odoo that answers management's questions in natural language, by text or voice, and sends a summary of operations every morning. The AI does not write SQL: it chooses among registered queries that read the ERP with the user's permissions.
proyectosProfesionales.problema: Management waited several days for consolidated reports: each department exported its own Excel file and they were merged by hand.
proyectosProfesionales.solucion: An assistant in Odoo that understands questions by text or voice, picks the matching registered query and answers with ERP data, respecting the permissions of whoever asks. Every morning it sends management a summary of operations.

proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: An Odoo 18 module with an OWL dashboard that consolidates sales on the central server: Sales, Units, Transactions, Products and Margins tabs by product family, brand and point of sale, with Odoo’s native company selector, a with/without IGV (sales tax) view and Excel export. Used by the 4 client companies and their 12 locations.
proyectosProfesionales.problema: Management needed to see sales and margins for every company and location together, not one by one.
proyectosProfesionales.solucion: An OWL dashboard inside Odoo 18 that queries PostgreSQL with SQL and only counts receipts accepted by SUNAT. It uses Odoo’s native company selector, shows amounts with or without IGV and exports to Excel.

proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: A module for counting inventory from a phone: camera scanning, blind counts, supervisor approval and stock adjustments that account for sales made during the count, with automatic alerts.
proyectosProfesionales.problema: Counting store inventory without stopping sales: an adjustment that overwrites stock with the counted quantity erases the sales made during the count, and large discrepancies or negative stock went unnoticed.
proyectosProfesionales.solucion: An Odoo module for the phone: items are scanned with the camera without showing the expected stock (blind count), the supervisor approves, and the adjustment is applied as a difference, so sales made during the count are kept. It sends automatic alerts for negative stock and large discrepancies.

proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: I took part in implementing a multi-site architecture on Odoo 18 for 4 retail companies (12 locations): a central VPS and a local PostgreSQL database per site, with catalog, prices and stock synchronized via API.
proyectosProfesionales.problema: Each store needed to keep operating on its own database while keeping its catalog, prices and stock aligned with headquarters. Adding a new store also had to be a standard process.
proyectosProfesionales.solucion: A central VPS and a local PostgreSQL database per site, synchronized through the API / JSON-RPC with a centralized module (connection, remote warehouse, price list and point of sale per site), and a standardized deployment with Debian, Nginx and Tailscale. I took part in its implementation.

proyectosProfesionales.titulo: Merchandise tracking with Power Automate and SharePoint
proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: Automated merchandise tracking between Wholesale, Sales and Warehouse using SharePoint forms and Power Automate flows, with emails to the people responsible and notifications of every status change.
proyectosProfesionales.problema: Merchandise tracking between Wholesale, Sales and Warehouse relied on scattered emails with no follow-up on status changes.
proyectosProfesionales.solucion: The store manager fills in a SharePoint form, and Power Automate flows email the people responsible and notify them of every status change.

proyectosProfesionales.descripcion: AS-IS / TO-BE modeling in BPMN for sales, warehouse, finance and HR, plus functional support for the Odoo 17 rollout: configuration, UAT and documentation.
proyectosProfesionales.problema: Sales, warehouse, finance and HR needed documented, redesigned processes for the Odoo 17 rollout.
proyectosProfesionales.solucion: AS-IS / TO-BE modeling in BPMN and functional support for Odoo 17: configuration, UAT and documentation.

logros: Built an AI assistant for Odoo that answers management's questions in natural language, by text or voice, and sends a summary of operations every morning. It replaces consolidated reports that took several days (each department exported its own Excel file and they were merged by hand). For security, the AI does not write SQL: it chooses among registered queries that read the ERP with the user's permissions.

Built the consolidated sales dashboard on the central server (sales, units, transactions, products and margins by product family, brand and point of sale, with Excel export), used by the 4 client companies and their 12 locations, with a multi-company filter and only receipts accepted by SUNAT (Peru's tax authority).

Built a mobile inventory count module: camera barcode scanning, blind counts, supervisor approval and stock adjustments that account for sales made during the count, with automatic alerts for negative stock and large discrepancies.

Took part in implementing a multi-site architecture on Odoo 18 for 4 retail companies (12 locations): a central VPS and a local PostgreSQL database per site, a centralized sync module for catalog, prices and stock via the API / JSON-RPC, and a standardized deployment with Debian, Nginx and Tailscale.
Built Power BI dashboards for every department: reports that took weeks to prepare are now generated automatically.

Automated merchandise tracking between Wholesale, Sales and Warehouse with Power Automate and SharePoint: the store manager fills in a form, and the system emails the people responsible and reports every status change, replacing scattered emails with no follow-up.

Built a web application for the Loss Prevention team that centralizes credit notes and stolen products from the stores, with permissions so each user sees only their own records; it replaced Excel files shared by hand.
Automated IT and Maintenance ticket handling: requests logged through a SharePoint form and an automatic notice to the user when their case is resolved.
Mapped and documented AS-IS / TO-BE processes (BPMN) for the move to Odoo 17, supporting configuration, user acceptance testing (UAT), manuals and user training.
Administered and maintained the corporate WordPress website, including hosting, domains and SSL.
Developed new features, forms, landing pages and responsive design (UX/UI).
Integrated the website with internal systems (Sistema PROGRESS).
Improved technical SEO, page speed, security and technical documentation, with version control in Git.
Designed responsive web pages with Elementor and WordPress for mobile, tablet and desktop.

competencias.descripcion: Process and requirements analysis for Odoo solutions and multi-site retail systems.
AS-IS / TO-BE processes in BPMN for sales, warehouse, finance and HR.
Configuration, UAT and functional support on Odoo 17.
Forms, request tracking and notifications with Power Automate and SharePoint.
Standardized site deployment with Debian, PostgreSQL, Nginx and Tailscale, as part of the multi-site architecture.
Manuals, process documentation and user training.
